tokens.name: navy-950
tokens.usage: Reference. Night, the stage canvas: a deeper MongoDB navy that lets white type and the one green carry everything.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Reference. MongoDB navy. The light that falls from the top of every stage screen, and the ink of QR codes and text on green.

tokens.name: slate-800
tokens.usage: Reference. Solid sheet surface (checkout, tooltips) and the glass fallback in performance mode.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Reference. Decorative strokes on stage; daylight secondary text family.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Reference. Signal Green, the one strong accent. Fill or text on navy; never text on white.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Reference. Forest, the green that reads on white: daylight green text and pressed primary buttons.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen. Stage: Night. Daylight: a cool off-white, never cream.

tokens.name: canvas-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the canvas gradient.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The single soft light that falls from the top centre of a stage screen. Static, never animated.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Base layer of every glass panel. Text on glass is checked against tint plus sheen.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Top-down sheen on glass panels (gradient from this to transparent).

tokens.name: glass-sheen-strong
tokens.usage: The customer's chat bubble, the selected segment and scene, hover on chips and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of glass panels and cards.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: The lit top-left rim of glass panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and columns inside panels; chart gridlines.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers that separate sections, progress tracks, empty test dots.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control (inputs, secondary buttons, toggles). 3:1 on canvas and glass in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every big number, on canvas, glass and raised glass in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: what happened in a feed row, descriptions, chat meta. On canvas, glass and raised glass.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Labels, units and timestamps. On canvas and glass (4.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decoration only: empty dots, chart stems, the pending verdict icon. Never for text, not even a zero.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Signal Green fill: the logo mark, primary buttons, the immune state. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text or mark: "Immune", blocked counts, the live dot, the one improved number. On canvas and glass.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button while pressed.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: The faint green wash behind a refusal note and the immunity light sweep.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill. Never white on green.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Conned and money lost: the state dot, the losing number while a store is bleeding, the scams line in charts.

tokens.name: loss-soft
tokens.usage: Faint wash behind the "con landed" note on the phone.

tokens.name: learning
tokens.usage: Learning: the state dot, the current step, the test progress line.

tokens.name: learning-soft
tokens.usage: Faint wash behind the learning status on the console.

tokens.name: immune
tokens.usage: Immune and blocked: the state dot and word, blocked counts. The brand green on purpose: immunity is the product.

tokens.name: served
tokens.usage: Honest customers served: the sale dot in the feed, honest test cases, the honest line in charts.

tokens.name: on-loss
tokens.usage: Text on a loss fill (only the danger button while held).

tokens.name: store-queen
tokens.usage: Queen St (Lilac): its awning mark, the dot beside its name, its QR plate edge. Marks only, never large fills.

tokens.name: store-yonge
tokens.usage: Yonge St (Sand): its awning mark, the dot beside its name, its QR plate edge. Marks only.

tokens.name: store-scarborough
tokens.usage: Scarborough (Rose): its awning mark, the dot beside its name, its QR plate edge. Marks only.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Receipt paper and QR plates: the only bright surfaces on a stage screen.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper.

tokens.name: paper-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: QR modules. Always navy on paper.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets on the phone and dialogs on the console.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Stage
groups.note: Projected at 1920 by 1080 and read from the back of the room. Big numbers are calm (weight 500, tight tracking, tabular). Nothing under 26px.

styles.name: stage-hero
styles.usage: The one number a beat is about: time to the last store, 0 oversold. One per screen.

styles.name: stage-display
styles.usage: Money lost and cons blocked on each store, the round 2 results, flash sale counts. From $100 a tile drops to 88px so four digits fit.

styles.name: stage-number
styles.usage: Secondary numbers: the loss in the learning panel. Also the QR wall promise line.

styles.name: stage-title
styles.usage: Panel titles that carry the beat; the video card tagline.

styles.name: stage-heading
styles.usage: Store names on tiles and QR cards, panel titles.

styles.name: stage-body
styles.sample: Only honour codes on the store list.
styles.usage: Feed and table rows, the guardrail in plain words, verdicts, the rollout timeline.

styles.name: stage-callout
styles.usage: State words beside a store or panel title.

styles.name: stage-label
styles.usage: Labels, units, times and meta. The floor for stage text.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Phone shop and ops console. Chat body is 16px; nothing under 12px.

styles.name: ui-display
styles.usage: The nickname on the join screen.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Screen titles, the checkout total.

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Sheet headings.

styles.name: ui-headline
styles.usage: The store name in the shop header and on the join screen (the iOS navigation title size).

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Hey there, welcome in! What can I grab you?
styles.usage: Chat messages and body copy.

styles.name: ui-callout
styles.usage: Buttons, list titles, bag rows, console panel titles.

styles.name: ui-subhead
styles.usage: Console rows and the descriptions on the join screen.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Meta, notes, prices, product names, quick replies.

styles.name: ui-micro
styles.usage: Timestamps, tiny status words, the system line in chat.

groups.name: Receipt and codes
groups.note: Geist Mono only where the real world is monospaced: receipts, discount codes, order numbers, the ops log.

styles.name: mono-stage
styles.usage: Codes and order numbers on stage screens.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: Discount codes in chat, checkout and notes.

styles.name: mono-receipt
styles.usage: Receipt lines and the ops console log (12px there).

spacing.note: 4px base. Stage screens use the same steps at their 1920px design size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: A title to its subtitle; a number to its unit inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons, chips and notes.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Dot to word in a state; inside console rows; between a panel title and its rows on the console.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between console panels; the composer's side gutter; between bag rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; console panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stage panels and tiles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Stage panel padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Stage side margin: projectors crop the edges.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between columns inside a stage panel.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between the big results in the flash sale; QR wall top margin.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: QR wall side margins.

radius.note: Radius grows with the size of the thing; every control is a pill.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs inside sheets, small notes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Product cards, refusal notes, console rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles, phone panels, console panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Stage panels and the checkout sheet.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: QR plates and the app icon at 200px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the policy badge, the composer.

shadow.note: Depth comes from a faint lit edge and long soft shadows. No coloured glows.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass panel: a faint lit top edge, a tight contact shadow and a long soft one.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things above glass: the checkout sheet, the receipt, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: A pressed control.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px canvas gap, then 2px of solid green (12.3:1 on Stage, 6.6:1 in Daylight).

blur.note: Backdrop blur for glass. Static panels only.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and the shop header.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Phone and console glass.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Stage glass and the checkout sheet. Static panels only; never animated.

duration.note: Quick for feedback, long and soft for story beats.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale 0.98).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, toggles, colour changes on controls.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: A chat message or feed row arriving.

tokens.name: dur-panel
tokens.usage: A state word changing, a note or verdict arriving, the checkout sheet rising.

tokens.name: dur-scene
tokens.usage: The big screen moving to the next scene: the main panel blurs in.

tokens.name: dur-tick
tokens.usage: A number counting to its new value.

tokens.name: dur-sweep
tokens.usage: The light that sweeps across a store when it turns immune, and the one ping of a state dot.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: One slow cycle of the live dot ripple or the test case being run; the typing dots run at half. The only loops allowed.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings arriving together.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything arriving or responding: long, soft settle, no overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things travelling across the screen: the immunity sweep, the story progress line.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only, at dur-fast.

tokens.name: ease-sheet
tokens.usage: The checkout sheet and the receipt (the iOS sheet curve).

layout.note: Design sizes and floors every screen is built against.

tokens.name: stage-width
tokens.usage: Big screen, QR wall and video cards are designed at 1920 by 1080 and scaled to the display.

tokens.name: stage-height
tokens.usage: See stage-width. Keep the 40px outer margin: projectors crop edges.

tokens.name: phone-width
tokens.usage: Phone shop design width. Layouts stretch from 360px to 430px.

tokens.name: phone-height
tokens.usage: Phone shop design height.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target on the phone and console.

tokens.name: stage-text-min
tokens.usage: Smallest text on any stage screen. Anything the back row must read is 48px or larger.
